name: Don Tonry
tribute: Don Tonry passed away May 17, 2013 at Yale New Haven Hospital. A 1960 Olympian, NCAA National Champion, and USA Hall of Fame inductee, Don transformed the Yale Gymnastic Club into a Varsity team that won three straight Ivy League Championships. He served as Yale's Associate Director for Physical Education and coached from his scooter while heroically battling Multiple Sclerosis. Don cared for all and was loved by all.
